app.title: Tunelito
app.subtitle: Open this, paste the key, send the address back.

warning.title: Only do this with someone you know.
warning.body: If a stranger asks you to paste a key, say no.

switch.confirm_on_body: This gives them a shell on this computer.
switch.need_key: Add your helper's public key before turning this on.

tunnel.off_hint: Turn it on to get a name you can send.
tunnel.snippet: Text for your helper's SSH config
tunnel.snippet_help: They paste this into ~/.ssh/config, install cloudflared, then run ssh with that name.

keys.title: Accepted keys
keys.label: Paste the key they sent you
keys.help: Paste the public key your helper sent you, for example on WhatsApp.
keys.revoke_on_off: Also forget the keys when turning off

sessions.title: Connections
sessions.loopback_note: Through the Cloudflare tunnel, this computer only sees 127.0.0.1. The real address is not visible here.
sessions.unmatched_hello: A hello arrived that did not match a session.

platform.linux_note: Linux service commands are planned and unit-tested. CI does not start sshd or open a public tunnel.
platform.untested_note: Windows and macOS service control is implemented and not executed in CI.

errors.invalid_public_key: That does not look like a public key.
errors.private_key_rejected: That is a private key. Paste the public key only.
errors.key_not_found: That key is not in the list.
errors.key_required: Add a public key before turning this on.
errors.checksum_mismatch: The downloaded cloudflared file did not match its checksum. It was not saved.
errors.unsupported_platform: This kind of computer is not supported for the cloudflared download.
errors.invalid_hostname: That tunnel name does not look valid.
errors.invalid_hello: The hello message could not be read.
errors.needs_admin: An administrator password is required to prepare SSH.
errors.refused_user: That account name is not allowed.
errors.tunnel_exited: The tunnel stopped. Access is off.
errors.io: A file could not be read or written.
